definition: פּוּךְ noun [masculine] antimony, stibium (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; compare possibly Arabic open, separate ; Syriac pulverize ; but פּוּךְ perhaps foreign word); — black mineral powder, for increasing brilliance of eyes by darkening edges of lids; ׳ וַתָּשֶׂם בֵּפּ עֵינֶוהָ 2Kgs 9:30 , ׳ תִּקְרְעִי וגו Jer 4:30 (on practice in Arabic see We GGN, 1893, 443 ; in Egypt, Lane Mod.Egypt.ed. 5, i. 45 f. ); figurative Isa 54:11 of dark cement setting off precious stones (but We DLZ, Aug. 2, 1890 Che Hpt and others read נֹפֶךְ q. v.); ׳ אַבְנֵי פ 1Chr 29:2 are perhaps stones of brilliant hue of antimony. — compare proper name קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ , and כָּחַל .
